test_skeleton_and_content_broadcast: test the skeleton and content broadcast of an integer list across MPI processes using manual broadcast
create_list_int_with_push_back: create a list_int object and push integer values into it using the push_back method
send_mpi_skeleton_to_process: send the skeleton of an integer list to a specific MPI process using comm send
receive_mpi_content_from_root: receive the content of a transferred list from the root process using comm recv
reverse_list_and_broadcast_content: reverse an integer list and broadcast its updated content to all MPI processes
